podcast.title: London Art Exhibition (September 2002)
podcast.body: In September 2002, an art exhibition featuring Stan Lee Donwood's work was inaugurated in London, showcasing his distinctive graphic art, particularly his contributions to Radiohead's visual identity. "En septiembre del 2002 en Londres se inauguró una exposición de arte muy especial, porque el protagonista de la exposición era Stan Lee Donwood."

podcast.title: Email Interview Published (September 2004)
podcast.body: After 1.5 years of effort, Stan Lee Donwood surprisingly agreed to an interview conducted entirely via email, even requesting the questions in advance. This interview, focusing on Radiohead's art, was published in September 2004 by Rolling Stone (UK) and subsequently translated and published by numerous magazines worldwide, becoming a significant event in the music world. "en septiembre justo dos años más tarde acababan publicando una entrevista de Stan Lee Donwood sobre el art de Radiohead y fue todo un acontecimiento. Esa entrevista fue traducida mucho si dié más y publicada muchísimas revistas por todo el mundo."

podcast.title: Amok (Atoms for Peace) Cover Art Continuation
podcast.body: Donwood continued the King Canute narrative through the album cover for Atoms for Peace's `Amok`. This artwork extends the theme by depicting the enraged sea razing an entire civilization, with clear allegories to environmental issues such as contamination, oil, and the petroleum industry. "es por otro lado la continuación de la ciudad reica no tener grande de cómo el mar contenía enfurecido y acaba rasando la civilización de entera aquí vemos además aleborías a la contaminación al petróleo al industria petróbifre de gra gasolina etc."

podcast.title: Bear Comic Inspiration - Allegory of Childhood
podcast.body: In an interview, Stanley Donwood explained that the inspiration for the macabre bear comic is an allegory drawn from children's fairy tales. He believes these stories often contain a dark, macabre illusion for children that is gradually forgotten as they grow older. The idea stemmed from a drawing of a bear he made with his two- or three-year-old daughter, which he interpreted as these innocent childhood figures aggressively and violently resurfacing from the past to torment them. "esta inspiración de los osos es una especie de alegoría que viene a sacarnos las historias de cuentos infantiles que en el fondo tienen una especie de ilusión macabra para los niños que poco a poco son olvidadas, sale de un dibujo de un oso que había hecho con su niña pequeña de dos de tres años y que el final le dio la interpretación de que un día esas pequeñas figuras en la infancia volvería a la infancia. A tormentarnos en el pasado de una manera agresiva y violenta, ahí viene a ser resurgir de esos osos de la infancia con ese aspecto tan macabro y tan violento."

podcast.title: Co-Designed Corrais Mobile Application
podcast.body: Stan Lee Donwood, along with Radiohead/Thom Yorke, co-designed a mobile application known as "los hechos a Corrais," which integrated image, sound, and an "astral journey" experience, acclaimed as an "authentic work of art." "llegaron incluso juntos a diseñar una aplicación de móvil que mezclaba imagen, sonido y una especie de viaje astral, los hechos a Corrais, la famosa aplicación que hicieron juntos que fue un auténtico obra de arte."

podcast.title: Collaboration with Dr. Shock
podcast.body: Stanley Donwood collaborated with Tom Yorke, under his pseudonym Dr. Shock, on various art projects. These collaborations included projections and the creation of a comic that became the origin of Radiohead's iconic bear logo. "trabajos con Stan Lee Donwood sobre artes, sobre proyectiones y estas cosas."

podcast.title: Comprehensive Radiohead Graphic Work
podcast.body: Following the success of *The Bends* cover, Stan Lee Donwood took on all graphic work for Radiohead, designing not only album covers but also singles, posters, badges, t-shirts, and even the band's websites, becoming an integral part of their visual brand. "él hizo todo el trabajo que tiene que ver con Radiohead. Como os dije él hace hasta los postres, él hace las chapas, él hace las camisetas, él diseñó hasta las webs del grupo."

podcast.title: Disproved Pseudonym Rumor with Thom Yorke Photo
podcast.body: A significant photograph emerged depicting Stan Lee Donwood alongside Thom Yorke distributing free newspapers for *The King of Limbs* release, which officially disproved the persistent rumor that Donwood was merely a pseudonym for Yorke. "Era una de las fotos que desmintió oficialmente que Thom Yorke y Stan Lee Donwood no eran la misma persona."

podcast.title: Doubts About His Existence
podcast.body: For many years, Stan Lee Donwood was so reclusive and enigmatic that people even doubted his real existence, leading to widespread and plausible rumors that he was actually Thom Yorke operating under a pseudonym for all of Radiohead's graphic work. "se llegó incluso a dudar de que existiese realmente. Hoy en día sabemos que en el sasis sino que es una persona real es un amigo personal de Thom Yorke, pero durante muchos años había el grandísimo rumor y con mucho sentido de que era el propio Thom Yorke que actúa con el Seidónimo de Stan Lee Donwood, el que hacía todo el trabajo gráfico del grupo."

podcast.title: Email-Only Contact Method
podcast.body: Stan Lee Donwood is notoriously difficult to contact, as he does not answer the telephone and can only be reached via email, making communication with him a unique and challenging endeavor. "no solo no se le ven público sino que tampoco contesta el teléfono, solo se puede poner en contacto con el mediante su correo electrónico."

podcast.title: Enigmatic Public Figure
podcast.body: Stan Lee Donwood is known for his enigmatic nature, consistently avoiding public appearances and even his own exhibition openings, which contributes to him being seen as more mysterious than Radiohead itself. "es una persona la que nunca se le ve y que nunca está en público."

podcast.title: Graphic Work for Thom Yorke's Solo Projects
podcast.body: Stan Lee Donwood has extended his graphic design work beyond Radiohead to Thom Yorke's solo projects, referred to as "A.R.I.C.E.," further cementing their artistic partnership. podcast.title: King Canute Triptych Artwork
podcast.body: The complete artwork for `The Eraser` is a triptych, much larger than the album cover itself. It illustrates the extended story of King Canute the Great attempting to halt the sea, his ultimate failure, and the ensuing consequences, depicting the enraged sea devastating everything in its path. "la obra completa es el tríptico que formaría este de aquí tenemos la historia ampliada del rey ca no te grande intentando contener el man finalmente no lo consigui por la parte de atrás del tríptico tenemos la consecuencia de su fracaso que es como el mar enfurecido enfadado con el hombre acaba de bastando toda su paso."

podcast.title: Reclusive Nature
podcast.body: Despite his significant contributions to Radiohead's visual output, Stanley Donwood maintains a private persona. He is known for giving interviews exclusively via email and never attending his own art exhibitions. podcast.title: Recognized Artist in Music and Art
podcast.body: Today, Stan Lee Donwood is a truly recognized artist, appreciated for his contributions both within the music industry and in the broader art world, reflecting the high quality and impact of his creative output. "Hoy en día él es un artista verdaderamente reconocido tanto en la música como en el arte y el trabajo que hace es increíble."

podcast.title: The Eraser (Thom Yorke) Cover Art
podcast.body: Donwood created the cover for Thom Yorke's 2006 solo album, `The Eraser`, which features an image of King Canute. podcast.body: Stan Lee Donwood and Thom Yorke met and became friends while they were university classmates at Oxford, a relationship that later proved pivotal for Donwood's career in graphic design. "eran compañeros de universidad en Oxford. Ahí es como se conocieron."
